findings: Full guest uc_sigmask low64 must equal the pre-handler entered kernel mask.
Staged edit requires requested KILL/STOP bits and a second raw live-mask query equal to the earlier handler mask; existing successful-query and expected handler-mask checks constrain this comparison.
Post-handler raw mask sample occurs immediately after assembly return and before sigaction/mask cleanup. Full64 comparison checks applied user mask edits and filtered KILL/STOP.
Harness cleanup cannot cause an implementation that ignores uc_sigmask edits to pass.
